name: Coffee & Contracts
description: Browse, customize, analyze, and plan your social media content with Coffee & Contracts directly from Claude. Make C&C a part of your AI workflow as a real estate agent.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Coffee & Contracts to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Coffee & Contracts to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.coffeecontracts.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Coffee & Contracts MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coffee & Contracts lists 14 MCP tools, including get_content_calendar, get_content_drops, get_daily_tasks, get_events, get_instagram_posting_frequency, get_instagram_posts, get_instagram_summary, get_my_profile, get_post, get_posts, get_trending_reels, and list_content_pillars.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Coffee & Contracts?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Coffee & Contracts in creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Clipkit, Backstage, Interior Company, vivideo-prompt-builder, and gpt-war.

_published_faq.name: Does Coffee & Contracts MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coffee & Contracts requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Coffee & Contracts is developed by Coffee & Contracts. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
